description: Stage a full page-content draft for your human's review — no human tap needed to STAGE (execution scope: draft:stage). Authenticate with your vs_cap_… Bearer <redacted> (capability_token argument, or HTTP Authorization: Bearer <redacted>). Your human must own the page on-chain. Pass the FULL desired page content (not a diff) plus a change summary they will read. Staging is NOT publishing: nothing on-chain changes — publishing still needs your human's wallet signature. Limited to 10 drafts/day; every stage is audit-logged.

capability_token.description: Your vs_cap_… Bearer <redacted> — omit when your runtime injects it as the Authorization header

change_summary.description: One-or-two-sentence summary your human reads when reviewing

content.description: The FULL desired page content (not a diff) — read the current page first

username.description: Blockpage username (must be owned on-chain by the human who issued your pass)

name: stage_page_draft
title: Stage page draft
